app.name: Margin
app.privacyShort: Your data stays in this browser. Settings and backup
app.privacyMobile: Your data stays in this browser. Settings and backup
app.langNotSaved: The language could not be saved. It applies until you close the tab.
app.documentTitle: {app} — Study your readings without losing the source

templates.investigation: What does page {page} say about "{title}"? What would you need to check to apply it?

interpretation.generated: Automatic explanation · not from the document
interpretation.none: No explanation. You can add one with Edit.
interpretation.label: Your explanation (optional)
interpretation.placeholder: Explain the idea in your own words. The app marks it as yours, not as part of the document.

claims.warning: Your text says something the quote does not.
claims.heuristic: The app compares your text word by word with the quote. It highlights words that are not in it, and words like "because" or "therefore" that add a cause. It does not check whether something is true.
claims.connector: Adds a cause or judgement the quote does not have
claims.trim: Keep only what the quote says
claims.trimmed: Removed what was not in the quote
claims.clean: Everything you wrote appears in the quote.

storage.unavailable: This browser cannot save data. Your work will be lost when you close the tab.
storage.invalidSaved: Your saved notes could not be read.
storage.invalidJson: Your saved notes could not be read.
storage.full: The browser is out of space and your last change was not saved. Download a backup and remove documents you no longer use.
storage.saveFailed: Your latest change could not be saved: {error}
storage.invalidBackupJson: This file is not a valid backup.
storage.invalidEnvelope: This file is not a {app} backup.
storage.invalidBackup: The backup is damaged or incomplete: {error}
storage.orphanCitation: A note quotes a document that is not in the backup: {title}
storage.invalidExcerpt: A quote does not match its page: {title}
storage.corruptSuffix: Meanwhile you are seeing the example. Your data was not deleted.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: This part of the app hit an error. The rest of the app is still running.
errors.notFoundBody: This section does not exist in {app}.

pdf.loadFailed: The PDF reader could not open in this browser. Try pasting the text.
pdf.password: This PDF has a password. Remove it and upload it again.
pdf.unreadable: This PDF could not be read. It may be damaged.
pdf.noText_one: This PDF has no selectable text ({count} page). It looks scanned, and {app} cannot read images. Copy and paste the text instead.
pdf.noText_other: This PDF has no selectable text ({count} pages). It looks scanned, and {app} cannot read images. Copy and paste the text instead.

add.title: Upload a document to study it
add.description: The app reads the text and suggests the key sentences. You decide which ones to keep as notes.
add.textPlaceholder: Paste your notes or a text here.
add.choose: Choose a PDF, TXT or MD file
add.chooseHint: The PDF needs selectable text. Scanned PDFs do not work.
add.privacy: The file is read in your browser. It is not sent to any server.
add.errType: ".{ext}" files cannot be read. Use PDF, TXT or MD.
add.errGeneric: The document could not be read. Nothing was saved.
add.found_one: The app suggests {count} sentence to turn into a note. Review it in "To review".
add.found_other: The app suggests {count} sentences to turn into notes. Review them in "To review".
add.foundNone: No useful sentences were found: they may be too short or mostly numbers. The full text is saved under Documents.

settings.title: Settings and your data
settings.description: Language, backup and how your information is stored.
settings.languageHint: Changes the app's text. Quotes from your documents stay in their original language.
settings.demoBody: The app comes with an example document so you can see how it works. You can remove it at any time.
settings.localBody: Only in this browser. It is not uploaded or synced to other devices, and it is not encrypted.
settings.sharedBody: anyone using this browser can see your notes.
settings.noAiBody: Your text is not sent to any service. Suggested sentences are exact copies from your document. Automatic questions and explanations are labelled as such.
settings.clearTitle: If you clear the browser's data,
settings.clearBody: you lose your notes. Download a backup to keep them.
settings.rejected: The backup was not loaded: {error} Your current notes did not change.
settings.valid: Valid backup: {sources} documents, {items} notes and {sessions} sessions. Loading it replaces everything you have now.
settings.erased: Your data was erased from this browser

overview.startBody: For now you are seeing an example about learning environments. Upload a PDF or paste your notes to study your own material.
overview.nothingApproved: No notes yet. Keep sentences in "To review" and they will appear here.
overview.stepReviewText: Keep the useful ones and discard the rest.
overview.stepStudyNeeds: Save at least one note first.
overview.demoBody: The example document is about learning environments. Its sentences are in "To review" so you can try the process. Nothing becomes a note without your approval.
overview.lead: Upload a PDF or your notes. {app} suggests the key sentences, you choose which to keep, and then you practise with flashcards and quizzes. Every note shows the exact page it came from.
overview.how1Body: A PDF with text, or your pasted notes.
overview.how2Body: The app suggests sentences and you keep the useful ones.
overview.how3Body: With flashcards and quizzes built from your notes.
overview.how4Body: What you have mastered and what to review next.

sources.title: Your documents
sources.intro: The full text of each document, page by page.
sources.emptyBody: Upload a PDF with text, a TXT or MD file, or paste your notes.
sources.demoNote: Example document included with the app.
sources.unverified: The text is shown as it came in the file.
sources.deleteBody: "{title}" and the notes that come only from it will be deleted. If you might need it, download a backup first.

goal.title: Why are you studying this document?
goal.subject: Goal
goal.subjectPlaceholder: e.g. prepare for the seminar on assessment
goal.priority: What do you need? Choose one or more
goal.effect: The app uses this to decide which sentences to show you first.
goal.demoDefault: Designing AI-supported learning environments for university teachers

priorities.exam_hint: Terms and items due for review first

review.title: Choose which sentences to keep
review.intro: The app copied these sentences from your document. Keep the ones that help you study as notes and discard the rest.
review.skipped_one: {count} not saved: tick both boxes first
review.skipped_other: {count} not saved: tick both boxes first
review.merged: Combined into one sentence with {count} quotes
review.checksNeeded: Tick both boxes to keep it
review.inboxClearBody: Upload a document or paste your notes to get new sentences.
review.noDiscardedBody: If you discard a sentence, it appears here and you can recover it.
review.checkAccurate: The note says the same as the quote
review.shortcuts: Keyboard shortcuts: A keep · E edit · D discard

editor.title: Edit note
editor.description: You can change the title, the type and your explanation. The quote cannot be edited, so it always matches the document.
editor.locked: Quote from the document · not editable
editor.lockedPlural: Quotes from the document · not editable
editor.check: Does your text say something the quote does not?

library.title: The notes you chose to keep
library.count_one: {count} note. It shows the page it came from.
library.count_other: {count} notes. Each one shows the page it came from.
library.emptyBody: Notes appear here when you keep sentences in "To review". Meanwhile you can search the text of your documents.
library.howtoNoneBody: Keep sentences of type Steps or Process and you will see an ordered guide here.
library.howtoNote: Steps are ordered by page. The app suggests this order; check the document if the order matters.
library.summaryNote: The quotes you kept from each document, in page order. The app writes nothing new.
library.summaryNone: No quotes kept from this document yet.

study.title: Practise with your notes
study.intro: Only the notes you kept are used. Notes due for review come first. Every answer shows the page it came from.
study.emptyBody: Keep at least one note in "To review" to use flashcards and quizzes.
study.quizHint: Fill the gap or find the page
study.focusHint: Read your notes with a timer
study.confidenceAsk: Before you see the answer: how sure are you?
study.confidenceFirst: Choose how sure you are to continue.

flash.recall: Complete the idea from memory. Then compare it with the quote.
flash.rateAfter: Compare with what you remembered. How did it go?
flash.doneBody: You remembered {confident}. The app scheduled when to review each one.

quiz.notEnough: Not enough notes for a quiz
quiz.notEnoughBody: Keep more sentences, ideally from different pages.
quiz.sourceInstruction: Which document and page is this quote from?
quiz.exactNote: The sentence comes exactly from your notes.

focus.logged: Session saved: {time} of reading and {count} notes read.
focus.choose: Choose which notes to read · {count} selected
focus.durationNote: Only time without pauses counts. You can finish early.

dash.title: How you are doing
dash.intro: These numbers come from your answers and sessions in this browser.
dash.emptyBody: Keep notes and practise with them to see your progress here.
dash.warningsBody: Times the app noticed your explanation added something the quote does not say.
dash.calibration: Does your confidence match your results?
dash.calibrationBody: Before each answer you say how sure you are. If you get more right when you say "sure" than when you say "unsure", you know yourself well.
dash.calLevel: How sure you said you were
dash.calNone: No data yet. It fills in as you answer flashcards and quizzes.

welcome.title: {app} helps you study what you read
welcome.body: Upload a PDF or your notes. The app suggests the key sentences and you choose which to keep. Then you practise with flashcards and quizzes, and every answer shows the exact page it came from.
welcome.privacy: Everything stays in your browser: no account needed, and your text is not sent to any AI.
